title: Medication ledger
idea: Medication ledger: A dated event history separates scheduled from recorded actions
audience: People who need to record event within a mobile surface.
worksWellWhen: Users need an accurate personal event record
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic ledger layout through its record event priority and explicit commitment contract: Viewing a reminder never records an action
navigation: Medication ledger keeps the current record event context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A dated event history separates scheduled from recorded actions
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to record event; users need an accurate personal event record
composition.priority: Viewing a reminder never records an action

imagery.role: Support the actual record event context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Use explicit dates and plain status text rather than color alone
Respect safe areas, native text scaling, keyboard intrusion and platform back behavior.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the medication ledger structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no record event content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Viewing a reminder never records an action
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized record event content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Viewing a reminder never records an action
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active record event context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure on target devices; test interrupted/resumed state and low-memory restoration.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
